result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The last restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Trattoria Piccol' — the restaurant name is truncated mid-word ('Piccolo' or similar) without an ellipsis, making it look like broken/incomplete text rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or equivalent) to restaurant name labels so truncated names end with '...' instead of cutting off mid-word, providing a cleaner visual indication that the text is truncated.
